metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: This iconic teen comedy features the same sharp wit and memorable high school dynamics that made Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You legendary.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Emma Stone's charismatic and fast-talking performance in this clever high school rom-com is perfect for fans of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Bright, uplifting, and stylish, this feel-good comedy features a bubbly protagonist with the same unstoppable optimism found in Clueless.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Like 10 Things I Hate About You, this is a hilarious modern adaptation of a classic Shakespeare play filled with goofy physical comedy and charm.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A delightfully colorful and quirky 90s comedy about female friendship that shares the fashion-forward, lighthearted spirit of Clueless.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical, action-packed fantasy romance with plenty of comedy, perfectly bridging your love for Practical Magic and D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good fantasy-adventure comedy. It captures the lighthearted epic quest tone of Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: This lighthearted fairytale parody blends fantasy, romance, and comedy in a way that matches the magic of Practical Magic and Clueless.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A highly-rated, delightfully funny modern whodunit mystery that will perfectly prepare you for Wake Up Dead Man.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A hilarious and colorful mystery sequel with a stellar ensemble cast, aligning wonderfully with your anticipation for Wake Up Dead Man.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black (The Nice Guys), this witty, fast-paced buddy-crime comedy shares the exact same chaotic and humorous detective energy.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: An exceptionally funny, action-packed mystery comedy that captures the high-stakes, hilarious chaos of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A lighthearted, colorful Southern heist comedy featuring quirky characters and a breezy, satisfying plot similar to Get Shorty.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A high-energy, laugh-out-loud space adventure with a great retro soundtrack, matching the comedic Marvel tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: Set inside a chaotic video game world, this fun-filled, high-octane adventure matches the exact feel of the modern Jumanji movies.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of fantasy, high adventure, action, and comedy, serving as a spiritual ancestor to Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: Featuring Heath Ledger (from 10 Things I Hate About You), this is a joyful, music-driven medieval action-comedy that is pure comfort food.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: Since you enjoyed Brüno, this iconic mockumentary from Sacha Baron Cohen delivers the same outrageous, barrier-pushing, laugh-out-loud comedy.

metas.name: Liar Liar
metas.description: Jim Carrey is at his physical comedy peak in this hysterical fantasy-comedy, matching the energy of Ace Ventura: Pet Detective.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A brilliant mockumentary comedy co-directed by Taika Waititi, capturing the unique, offbeat humor of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, visually stunning French romantic comedy that shares the cozy magical realism and charm of Little Amélie and Practical Magic.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: An incredibly high-energy, hilarious, and heartwarming animated adventure that fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl will appreciate for its visual creativity.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A highly stylized, fast-paced comedy that blends romantic comedy, video game visuals, and exciting action, similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A highly underrated, feel-good post-apocalyptic adventure that is lighthearted, funny, and filled with imaginative creature designs like Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A wild, fast-paced action-comedy featuring colorful assassin characters and witty banter, perfect for fans of Thor: Ragnarok and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: An incredibly fun, lighthearted, and fast-paced history-adventure movie that is the ultimate low-stress popcorn watch.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: An absurd, quote-filled fashion-world comedy that hits the same hilarious, over-the-top notes as Ace Ventura and Brüno.

metas.name: The Heat
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud buddy-cop comedy starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy that perfectly matches the comedic action of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A lighthearted superhero movie centered on a kid who gets magical powers, blending the fun fantasy of Jumanji with lighthearted action.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest, fastest-paced comedies. Its slapstick humor and sharp dialogue will appeal to fans of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
metas.description: A brilliantly goofy and colorful spy parody that matches the retro-comedy vibes and physical humor of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Warm Bodies
metas.description: A clever, lighthearted romantic comedy with a supernatural twist, sharing the unique, wholesome charm of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: A breathtakingly beautiful anime fantasy movie from Studio Ghibli, perfect for fans of whimsical worlds like Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A high-energy, endlessly quotable teen sports comedy that fits perfectly alongside 90s classics like Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Can't Hardly Wait
metas.description: The ultimate late-90s high school party comedy, featuring an ensemble cast and the exact same nostalgic energy as Clueless.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A highly energetic, hilarious animated supervillain comedy with great music and a feel-good message, perfect for relaxing.

metas.name: The Rundown
metas.description: An underrated action-comedy starring Dwayne Johnson in a jungle setting, capturing the same fun, lighthearted adventure vibe as Jumanji.

metas.name: Spirited Away
metas.description: A magical, beautiful fantasy masterpiece that matches the enchanting visual world-building of Fantastic Beasts and anime styling of Little Amélie.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming romantic comedy with a light sci-fi/time-travel twist that leaves you feeling deeply comforted and uplifted.

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: The quintessential fun-filled treasure hunt adventure movie, capturing the timeless magic and group camaraderie found in D&D.
